replay.scope: Offline replay of existing baseline provider responses through the new actual default Session path. All initial/follow-up payload bytes and candidate maps are checked before each recorded response. Not independent new model-quality or performance evidence.
replay.compared: Every Session field except elapsed_ms; every full advisor field except timestamps, elapsed time, derived receipt digest, and index_cache telemetry; all per-request fields except timestamp/elapsed time. Strict correctness and all recorded model errors retained.

native_input_identity.native_timing_attribution: Native measures unchanged full200 baseline local preparation plus Astra-low response in its separate run. Exact inputs match memo candidate; this proof does not transfer memo preparation timings or equate runtime implementations.

decision.runtime: retain bounded memo as a release-candidate preparation optimization
decision.rationale: Identical recorded requests and outcomes; reduced local preparation in both catalogs and lower measured total latency in the 718-entry mixed catalog.
tradeoffs: Small skill-only cohort was slower overall (442.734 versus 427.511 ms) with 79/80 versus 80/80 accepted selections.
Mixed cohort scored 173/200 versus 174/200; all differing successful payloads and candidate maps were identical.
A new Session includes detached index construction and retained-size accounting; persistent reuse needs the owning process.
Model/service variability is consistent with identical-input output differences, but observed quality declines remain failures, not non-regression passes.
decision.production_promotion: Open: representative native workflow utility remains unqualified.

timing_note: Preparation and request-phase medians are separate distributions; their medians need not sum to the total. These diagnostics do not isolate network, provider or instrumentation effects.

independent_audit.audit_method: Independent frozen-source, request/response, outcome, score, Native event and timing reconstruction; no new API calls. No raw benchmark prompts, capability identifiers or session identifiers included.

checks: all frozen inputs and run-start anchor
96 schedule slots and independent strict selection grading
raw output schema and candidate map
one observed model turn per slot
requested model and strict isolation flags
no observed tool execution or residual process groups
limits: Model name is requested configuration; resolved backend revision is not exposed.
Provider-reported cached input tokens are preserved; no decision cache or answer reuse is used.
Native uses baseline preparation plus observed model turn in a separate measurement window; no whole-task or skill-loading timing claim.
Process cleanup and tool absence are checked from recorded adapter results and complete event streams.

input_identity.timing_attribution: Native uses full200 baseline preparation plus the observed Astra-low model turn. Inputs equal memo inputs; prep timings and runtime implementations are not equated.

primary_memo_disagreements.provider_output_difference: Baseline SINGLE; memo PAIR followed by STOP. Fail-closed CLARIFY is retained.
primary_memo_disagreements.inference: Different provider answers to identical inputs; no observed payload or memo-corruption defect.

mixed_memo_disagreement.provider_output_difference: Same initial pair; different follow-up tool choice.
mixed_memo_disagreement.inference: Different provider answers to identical inputs; the extra incorrect observation remains included.

hussi_original_abstentions.meaning: The intended skills were suggested but did not cross the published autonomous-routing threshold.

repository_validation.evidence_basis: Existing execution logs reviewed independently; tests were executed by the implementing agent, not rerun by this auditor.

limits: Primary skill selection is slower and 79/80 for memo in this run; the negative result is retained.
Mixed-catalog total improvement is cohort evidence, not a universal speed guarantee.
Native and TypeSafe runs have separate measurement windows; provider backend revisions are unresolved.
Native reports provider-side prefix-cache usage; no decision cache or reused answer is used.
Offline replays and unit cases are distinct evidence and do not add new live model observations.
No worldwide fastest or best-skill claim is supported.
archive/CLI evidence only; no native host activation or utility comparison
local packages are not published release subjects
